operator_summary: EA release control is green, but whole-project gold is blocked by unproven external planes.
rules: EA flagship readiness does not imply whole Chummer project readiness.
Unknown external planes block whole-project gold claims.
Draft/operator LTD lanes cannot be treated as runtime or publication truth.
Design mirror parity is bounded; canonical product/UI proof must come from owning repos.
Memorial voice/realtime readiness requires its own browser, STT, TTS, and latency receipts.

planes.title: Executive Assistant Release Control
planes.claim: EA core workspace and release-control proof are green only when the EA receipt, weekly pulse, and browser workflow proof are green.

planes.title: Fleet Journey Gates
planes.claim: Fleet journey gates are separate evidence; EA only consumes their generated summary.

planes.title: Design Surface And Mirror Boundary
planes.claim: EA owns a bounded mirror and cannot infer all Chummer product design readiness from mirrored docs alone.
design_notes: Whole-project design gold requires canonical product/UI review receipts outside the EA mirror.
The EA mirror may be green while product-wide visual polish remains unproven.

planes.title: Chummer Core Rules And Data Correctness
planes.claim: No EA-local receipt proves complete Chummer rules/data correctness.

planes.title: Chummer Desktop/UI Product Surface
planes.claim: No EA-local receipt proves desktop UI, visual polish, accessibility, or launcher flows end to end.

planes.title: Chummer Hub And Public Web
planes.claim: No EA-local receipt proves public hub, account, download, support, or landing surfaces are production-gold.

planes.title: Mobile And Second-Device Continuation
planes.claim: No EA-local receipt proves mobile, tablet, or second-device continuation journeys.

planes.title: Media Factory And Video Publication
planes.claim: MagicFit, JoggAI, Poppy, and video/avatar lanes are governed draft/operator or candidate lanes unless separate publish receipts exist.
missing_evidence: approved render receipts for each published asset

planes.title: Memorial Voice / Realtime Demo
planes.claim: Memorial voice quality and realtime conversation readiness must be proven by its own browser+STT+TTS exit gate, not by EA release readiness.

planes.title: LTD Provider Lanes
planes.claim: Provider lanes may be verified runtime, draft/operator, or parked inventory; they are not product truth.
